card.fact_statement: The United Nations appealed for $74 million to help aid those impacted by Hurricane Melissa in Cuba.
card.source_span: the United Nations appealed for $74 million on November 5 to help aid those impacted by Melissa in Cuba.

target_qa_variants.question: Um wie viel Geld baten die Vereinten Nationen zur Unterstützung der von Hurrikan Melissa in Kuba Betroffenen?
target_qa_variants.source_span: the United Nations appealed for $74 million on November 5 to help aid those impacted by Melissa in Cuba.
